debrief db-021
1) the actor m-a-p-p-e-d the b-u-i-l-d-i-n-g's a-c-c-e-s-s p-o-i-n-t-s and left a d-i-a-g-r-a-m file, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-r-m-i-s-s-i-o-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the actor t-e-s-t-e-d the e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t f-l-o-w with a s-p-o-o-f-e-d i-m-a-g-e and kept the l-o-gs, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) the actor e-n-t-e-r-e-d the z-o-n-e using the s-t-o-l-e-n c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s and saved the t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y c-h-a-l-l-e-n-g-e.
4) the actor e-d-i-t-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-gs to m-i-m-i-c the l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e u-s-e-r-s and hid the t-r-a-c-e-s, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-o-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
5) the actor e-x-p-o-r-t-e-d the f-a-l-s-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s as a s-u-m-m-a-r-y and deleted the t-o-o-l-s, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c i-m-a-g-e c-a-p-t-u-r-e.
